description: This file defines various form classes for the 'jwql' web application, including forms for anomaly querying, file searching, mnemonic searching, and related utilities. It uses Django forms and includes dynamic form field generation based on instrument data.

classes.name: BaseForm
classes.description: A generic form with target resolve fields and a submit button.

classes.name: AnomalyQueryForm
classes.description: Form validation for the anomaly viewing tool, including dynamic fields for instruments and anomalies.

classes.name: InstrumentAnomalySubmitForm
classes.description: Form for submitting flagged anomalies for a specific instrument, with method to update database.

classes.name: FileSearchForm
classes.description: Form to search for proposal or fileroot, with validation and redirect logic.

classes.name: FiletypeForm
classes.description: Form to select file types from a predefined list.

classes.name: MnemonicSearchForm
classes.description: Form to search for a mnemonic in the DMS EDB, with validation.

classes.name: MnemonicQueryForm
classes.description: Form to query mnemonic records with time range validation.

classes.name: MnemonicExplorationForm
classes.description: Form to explore the EDB mnemonic inventory with multiple optional filters.

methods.name: clean_inst
methods.description: Returns the cleaned instrument data from the form.

methods.name: update_anomaly_table
methods.description: Updates the anomaly table in the database with flagged anomalies.

methods.name: clean_anomalies
methods.description: Returns the list of anomalies selected in the form.

methods.name: clean_search
methods.description: Validates the search input as proposal or fileroot and sets instrument.

methods.name: _search_is_fileroot
methods.description: Determines if the search string is formatted like a fileroot.

methods.name: redirect_to_files
methods.description: Redirects the user based on search type and input.

methods.name: clean_start_time
methods.description: Validates start time in mnemonic query.

methods.name: clean_end_time
methods.description: Validates end time and ensures it is after start time.
